019package org.apache.bcel.generic;
020
021/**
022 * Super class for JSR - Jump to subroutine
023 */
024public abstract class JsrInstruction extends BranchInstruction implements UnconditionalBranch, TypedInstruction, StackProducer {
025
026    /**
027     * Empty constructor needed for Instruction.readInstruction. Not to be used otherwise.
028     */
029    JsrInstruction() {
030    }
031
032    JsrInstruction(final short opcode, final InstructionHandle target) {
033        super(opcode, target);
034    }
035
036    /**
037     * @return return address type
038     */
039    @Override
040    public Type getType(final ConstantPoolGen cp) {
041        return new ReturnaddressType(physicalSuccessor());
042    }
043
044    /**
045     * Returns an InstructionHandle to the physical successor of this JsrInstruction. <B>For this method to work, this
046     * JsrInstruction object must not be shared between multiple InstructionHandle objects!</B> Formally, there must not be
047     * InstructionHandle objects i, j where i != j and i.getInstruction() == this == j.getInstruction().
048     *
049     * @return an InstructionHandle to the "next" instruction that will be executed when RETurned from a subroutine.
050     */
051    public InstructionHandle physicalSuccessor() {
052        InstructionHandle ih = super.getTarget();
053        // Rewind!
054        while (ih.getPrev() != null) {
055            ih = ih.getPrev();
056        }
057        // Find the handle for "this" JsrInstruction object.
058        while (ih.getInstruction() != this) {
059            ih = ih.getNext();
060        }
061        final InstructionHandle toThis = ih;
062        while (ih != null) {
063            ih = ih.getNext();
064            if (ih != null && ih.getInstruction() == this) {
065                throw new IllegalStateException("physicalSuccessor() called on a shared JsrInstruction.");
066            }
067        }
068        // Return the physical successor
069        return toThis.getNext();
070    }
071}
